recommendation: Keep the commit. If a generated CanonicalResource list becomes supported on canonicalresource.html, consider replacing the maintained list with generated output to prevent future drift.
issue_request: FHIR-31962 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that canonicalresource.html include the same table/list of CanonicalResource-inheriting resources that appeared on references.html#canonical; the recorded resolution was to put the table both places.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-31962 was found for the relevant paths. The CanonicalResource introduction originally used the [%canonical-resources%] include and was later changed to a maintained explicit list, so the requested content was present but subject to drift.
additional_context: FHIR-41583 later made Group carry all CanonicalResource interface elements. Current source/fhir.ini keeps CanonicalResource and Group in build scope, current Group source declares the CanonicalResource template/base and Group.url canonical identifier, and Zulip discussion confirms Group was being handled as a CanonicalResource.
reconciliation: Edited source/canonicalresource/canonicalresource-introduction.xml to add Group to the maintained list of resources implementing CanonicalResource.
